blocks.text: HE TRADED THE LISBON SUN|FOR THE LONDON BOMBS.
THE SPIES BERLIN SENDS TO ENGLAND, WE ARREST THEM ALL. THOSE WHO COOPERATE KEEP WRITING TO BERLIN.
BUT WE ARE THE ONES WHO DICTATE THEIR LETTERS. YOU WILL BE ONE OF THEM.
THE BRITISH GAVE HIM|A CODE NAME: TRICYCLE.
THE SYSTEM WAS CALLED DOUBLE CROSS.|IT HAD JUST FOUND ITS BEST PLAYER.
